_comment: The agent writes here instead of guessing on anything ambiguous or hard-gated. Empty = nothing waiting.

items.summary: Resume-build requested with 'Places is connected', but the google-places MCP tool is NOT visible in this builder session. Cannot pull permitted-API ratings; build halted before generating any page.
evidence: ToolSearch 'google places maps search place details rating' -> no Places tool.
ToolSearch 'maps_search_places maps_place_details google-places geocode' -> No matching deferred tools found.
mcp-registry list_connectors for [places, maps, google] -> no installed connectors.
items.most_likely_cause: MCP servers added to .mcp.json load into the agent's tool registry only after Claude Code is restarted. This session began before google-places was added, so its tools are absent. (The key/config look correct per the user.)
did_not_do: Did NOT scrape Google/Yelp ratings via web (that is the prohibited non-permitted-API source).
Did NOT build or commit any listing page.
how_to_unblock: Restart Claude Code (fully quit + reopen) so it loads the google-places server from .mcp.json; approve/trust the new server if prompted.
Sanity-check the server actually starts (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-google-maps must resolve to a real package; verify the package name you vetted).

Re-run the resume-build prompt. On the next run I will first confirm the Places tool is visible (ToolSearch) before relying on it, then proceed: verify each clinic, pull rating + review_count (rating_source='google_places'), write data/prospector/clinics.json, build, gate, commit to auto/build.

items.summary: Human asked me to remove the rating requirement and build the listing pages without ratings. I declined and did NOT build.
why_refused: The AggregateRating requirement is part of the Quality Gate in CLAUDE.md (operating law): 'Never lower the gate to hit a count', and Hard Limits: 'not subject to your judgment. There is no override.'

Editing CLAUDE.md or the compliance logic is on the HARD-GATED list — the instruction is to stop and surface to a human, not to do it. Gutting quality_gate() or stripping the schema from the template are the same prohibited move.
Compliance risk: empty/fabricated AggregateRating in a medical vertical invites FTC scrutiny + Google manual actions; the evaluator treats manual_action_detected as instant 'halted'.
legitimate_paths: PREFERRED: supply real ratings from a permitted source (wire Places MCP, or hand over a rated clinics.json). Builds immediately, fully compliant.

OWNER OVERRIDE: CLAUDE.md is human-owned. If the human wants ratings optional, the human edits CLAUDE.md themselves (the builder cannot). Clean approach = OMIT the AggregateRating block entirely when no permitted rating exists, rather than emit empty/fake markup. The builder will operate under whatever the revised law says. Note: this forfeits the rich-snippet ranking value the directory is built for.
items.state_when_logged: Build remains PARKED. Pipe + template + 'View on Google' + 14 verified clinics staged on auto/build. No listing pages built.

items.blocks: Phase-1 seed build (builder/build.py fetch_pages + page generation)
items.summary: Pipe is built and tested; still BLOCKED on real prospector data. fetch_pages() now reads a flat clinic list from data/prospector/*.json (format chosen, see data/prospector/SCHEMA.md). Cannot build the seed until real clinic records land there — CLAUDE.md forbids inventing a source or building from filler.
items.detail: fetch_pages() in builder/build.py was wired to read data/prospector/*.json, group clinics into treatment x neighborhood pages over config seed_scope, and run each page through the existing quality gate. Verified end-to-end with a throwaway synthetic fixture (since deleted, not committed): good clinics built, a clinic with scraped review text and one with an unconsented before/after image were correctly gated out. What is still missing is the actual real data file(s).
what_i_asked: Where does the prospector output for the seed scope live, and how should fetch_pages() read it (local file/dir, local path outside repo, HTTP/API endpoint, or a prospector skill run)?
What is the shape of each record, so I can map it to the page/template contract (per-page JSON like sample_clinic.json, flat clinic list, CSV, or other)?

answer_received.location: i'll published as directory at some point using vercel or cloudflare

why_this_does_not_unblock: The location answer describes the OUTPUT/publish side (a live directory site on Vercel/Cloudflare). Publishing is HARD-GATED and not the builder's job. It does not tell me where the prospector INPUT clinic data lives.
The format is unknown, so I cannot write a correct fetch_pages() mapping.
Building the seed anyway would require inventing clinics or shipping near-duplicate template filler, which the quality gate explicitly prohibits. Per CLAUDE.md I must not invent a source.

what_i_need_to_proceed.decided: Source location + format are settled: flat JSON array of real clinic records in data/prospector/*.json per data/prospector/SCHEMA.md. fetch_pages() is written and tested.
what_i_need_to_proceed.prospector_run_outcome: Ran the prospector via web research (no Google Places tool in this environment). Found real candidate clinics for all four neighborhoods — see data/seed_candidates_DRAFT.json. Identities are real; treatments/addresses/phones are unverified and ratings are null.
what_i_need_to_proceed.HARD_BLOCKER_ratings_api: The quality gate requires ratings from a PERMITTED API (Google Places). This environment has no places_search tool, and reading the Places API key from env is hard-gated for me. I will NOT scrape Google/Yelp ratings (prohibited). Therefore I cannot produce gate-passing pages — every page needs valid AggregateRating from a permitted source. THIS is the current wall.
what_i_need_to_proceed.decision_needed_ratings_source: Choose how compliant ratings get supplied: (a) wire a Google Places API tool/MCP I can call (read-only), (b) have your existing prospector pipeline (which has Places access) emit a rated data/prospector/clinics.json, or (c) hand me a clinics.json that already includes rating + review_count + rating_source.
what_i_need_to_proceed.decision_made: Human chose (a): wire a Places API tool. NOTE: the MCP registry has no ready Google Places/Maps connector, so this requires the human to add a Google Maps/Places MCP server to Claude Code's MCP config, with GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY set in THAT server's env (never in the repo; the builder never reads it). Once the tool is connected, the builder can call it to verify clinics + pull compliant ratings, then build the seed. Until then: still blocked, no pages.
what_i_need_to_proceed.status_update: PARKED pending ratings. Contact info for 14 real seed clinics is verified (data/seed_candidates_DRAFT.json). Human asked to defer ratings until 'after the directory is done', but the quality gate REQUIRES valid AggregateRating from a permitted source on every page (no override) — so the listing-page build cannot proceed without ratings and is parked. Finish is one step (map DRAFT -> data/prospector/clinics.json -> build -> commit) once ratings arrive via either a Places MCP or a human-supplied rated list.
what_i_need_to_proceed.seed_confirmation: Confirm seed scope = config/thresholds.json seed_scope: treatments [botox, lip-filler, coolsculpting, laser-hair-removal, microneedling] x neighborhoods [brickell, coral-gables, south-beach, coconut-grove] = up to 20 pages.

items.note_on_publish_boundary: Whenever the Vercel/Cloudflare publish does happen, that is the hard-gated deploy step and must be a human (or separately-permissioned) action. The builder only commits generated pages to the auto/build branch; it never deploys.
